posts.text:
Given that SCOTUS (w/ a Trump admin assist) nullified what remains of the Voting Rights Act, is it going to be awkward to say this is all necessary to enforce the VRA??

(I wouldn't put it past them. Or to say "this will help Republicans partisan gerrymander, which is now our constitutional right")
posts.summary: Criticizes SCOTUS for nullifying Voting Rights Act protections
